bioconda.name: spice
bioconda.summary: Subclone Probability Inference of Copy-number Evolution (SPICE)
bioconda.description: SPICE is an algorithm that reconstructs hundreds to thousands of equally plausible copy-number alteration (CNA) phylogenies for each tumour, taking as input clone-specific CNA profiles inferred from either bulk DNA sequencing data using copy-number deconvolution methods or from single-cell DNA sequencing data by clustering cells with similar CNAs. Rather than relying on a single, error-prone estimate, SPICE enumerates multiple equally-plausible CNA phylogenies to quantify uncertainty for each inferred CNA event.
